name: Thorns: Police never sleeps
source:
Thorns. Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel that tells the tragic story of a young police officer.

Ocean 17 is a city that makes no exceptions. He doesn't care how much money, friends or abilities you have. This is a city that is always ready to move forward towards a bright future, destroying and digesting millions of human lives in its belly.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
荆棘。《警察不眠》是一部动感视觉小说，讲述了一名年轻警察的悲惨故事。

Ocean 17是一座无一例外的城市。他不在乎你有多少钱、有多少朋友、有多少能力。这是一座时刻准备着走向光明未来的城市，在它的腹中摧毁和消化着数百万人的生命。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908340/]Steam[/url]]
